_about: Exploration only, for the owner to react to: mood sketches for the later zones in canon/world-bible.md. These zones are one-line sketches in the canon and nothing here is settled. Same fragments as v0.

subjects.subject: Endless shallow tidal flats like a mirror reflecting the sky, ankle-deep clear water over pale sand, scattered salt crystal spires, a colossal pale tree root running across the flats and dipping into the distant sea, wooden stilt walkways.
A cheerful fishing town on wooden stilts above mirror-bright tidal shallows, houses roofed with pale shells, nets and paper fish kites, small flat boats, a lighthouse built from a tall salt crystal.
A crab the size of a pony with a shell of clear blue-white salt glass crystals, pale sandy legs, two large pincers, small friendly-looking eyes on stalks.
A flooded cavern under the sea floor where a giant pale tree root drinks from a glowing blue pool, walls of salt crystal, shafts of light through water above, stone walkways just under the surface.

A warm volcanic mountain ridge with dark rock, glowing orange cracks, rising heat haze and floating embers, a colossal pale tree root climbing over the ridge, rope bridges and cliff paths, hang gliders in the sky.

A cliffside town of forges and chimneys carved into warm dark rock, glowing furnace doors, big bellows, water wheels, banners, cable lifts between ledges, sparks drifting in the air, friendly and busy.
A sturdy mountain goat with dark charcoal fur, curled horns glowing orange like hot iron at the tips, small embers drifting from its hooves, proud stance, side-on three-quarter view.
A simple hand-held glider made of a light wooden frame and two large pale leaf-shaped cloth wings with green veins, a leather hand bar underneath.

A silent forest of pale grey petrified stone trees in permanent blue twilight under the shadow of an immense canopy far above, soft gold light points drifting between the trunks, a narrow path, mist on the ground.

A hushed village built among giant petrified stone tree trunks in blue twilight, round doors in the trunks, hundreds of small warm lanterns, villagers in soft grey cloaks walking quietly, bells wrapped in cloth.
A tall graceful stag made of pale grey petrified wood and stone, antlers like bare stone branches hung with tiny gold light points, calm closed eyes, moss on its back.

Standing at the foot of a tree trunk so vast it fills the whole horizon like a pale cream cliff wall rising into the clouds, bark ridges the size of mountains, gigantic roots forming arches, a tiny road and tiny travellers for scale, gold light points drifting everywhere.
